\[ c + d = 10a \]
\[ cd = -11b \]

\[ a + b = 10c \]

\[ a + b = 10c \]

\[ ab = -11d \]

\[ cd = -11 \left( \frac{-11d}{a} \right) = \frac{121d}{a} \]

\[ \left( \frac{10a - d}{1} \right) d = \frac{121d}{a} \]
\[ (10a - d)d = \frac{121d}{a} \]
\[ 10ad - d^2 = \frac{121d}{a} \]
\[ 10ad^2 - a d^2 = 121d \]
\[ 9ad^2 = 121d \]
\[ 9ad = 121 \]
\[ d = \frac{121}{9a} \]

Now, substitute \(d = \frac{121}{9a}\) back into the equation \(a + b = 10c\):
\[ a + b = 10c \]
\[ b = 10c - a \]

Next, substitute \(d = \frac{121}{9a}\) into the equation \(ab = -11d\):
\[ ab = -11 \left( \frac{121}{9a} \right) = -\frac{1331}{9a} \]

\[ 10ac - a^2 = -\frac{1331}{9a} \]
